claims.title: Honestly generated KZG openings satisfy the pairing equation
claims.statement: For a coefficient vector, a generated power SRS and an evaluation point, KZG.correctness shows that the model's generated opening verifies for the polynomial's evaluation.

details: Prime p; prime-order groups G1, G2 and Gt with the module and equality structures in the theorem; the group order (Nat.card G1 = p) is carried by the PrimeOrderWith class instances, not an explicit theorem hypothesis after upstream #1468.
A bilinear pairing, generators, degree parameter n, SRS secret a, coefficient vector and evaluation point z, under the recorded Lean definitions.
Transitive dependencies and axioms have not been audited for this revision.

limitations: Algebraic correctness is not binding, knowledge soundness, ceremony security or zero knowledge.
Generic single-point coefficient-form opening, not Ethereum's batched cell verifier, blob encoding, BLS12-381 implementation or a deployed prover.

scope.statement: Parametric algebraic correctness for degree parameter n; n is not a finite model-checking search bound.
abstractions: Prime-order groups and bilinear pairing; ideal generated power SRS; coefficient-form polynomials.

binding.explanation: Related algebraic KZG model. Fulu calls a batched cell-proof verifier; the cited ArkLib theorem only covers its own single-opening algebra and is not a conformance result.

review.notes: Inspected Verified-zkEVM/ArkLib 31ff7ddf..e272c348 (fast-forward; #1473 #1474 #1480 #1479). Pinned KZG Basic.lean and Correctness.lean are byte-identical; Algebra.lean (Groups.PowerSrs.generate) is unchanged. KZG.correctness still states that generateOpening verifies via commit, divByMonic and verifyOpening. lean-toolchain stays v4.35.0; mathlib 56a00585 and CompPoly a1ac8925 are unmoved; CompPoly requires only mathlib. The only changed VCVio import in the closure is QueryImpl/Constructions/Core.lean: it drops a redundant LawfulMonad hypothesis from two simulateQ induct lemmas unused by those definitions or KZG.correctness. Inherited PolyFun moved with VCVio and is not imported by the algebraic statement. Changed ToCompPoly Arithmetic and Primitive modules are outside that closure. Claim text, assumptions, limitations and the beacon related-model binding need no edits. Source and applicability review only; no Lean replay or axiom audit.
